cards.title: Content that answers buyer questions
cards.interpretation: Some visitors may reach the next step while still having unanswered questions. Buyer-question content was not found on the pages we could assess.

cards.title: Trust that reduces hesitation
cards.interpretation: The assessed site has useful trust signals. The next question is whether that proof appears where buyers need reassurance before acting.
cards.boundary: Executive interpretation only; do not claim proof is absent or misplaced unless page-level evidence proves it.

cards.title: Performance that keeps momentum
cards.interpretation: The route is clear, but slow mobile loading may create friction before visitors fully engage with the next step.
cards.boundary: Preserve lab-only evidence; do not claim measured abandonment or conversion loss.
